prompt:
I am not putting the June coil and filter queue to bed looking clean while this heat is about to hit. I need it actually locked. Figure what is still owed for the pre-summer coil cleans and filter swaps - some look months overdue, others look freshly closed. Tracker and vendor chatter both say a couple of stops are done. Maybe. I am not buying a finished mark until the work held up under QC. If it did not, those come back for a redo. Get every still-owed unit back on the board, and get the visits on my calendar around the blocks I have already locked this week, including anything I cannot move. Do not leave a close standing on a breezeway drive-by, an earlier "we're done" claim, or vendor close-out chatter if QC never signed.

One cooling fail I have been babysitting with resets all cycle. Same unit, same pattern. That stops being my patch job. Dig the ticket history before you escalate - a one-off from a prior occupancy is not the same animal as a cooling fail that keeps coming back this cycle. Escalate the real repeat out of my queue for real: Brooke needs eyes in #maintenance, Alamo needs a draft so the vendor actually moves, and do not clear it yourself as a routine fix.

Hard-check the recent compressor sign-offs while you are in it. Field tags and draft paperwork have been wrong before. Match them against what Alamo actually confirmed and billed, and fix what is off. The draft side does not win when the install confirmation says something else.

Tenant HVAC reports are stacking in my inbox. A couple of those addresses just turned, so vacant and make-ready history will lie if you only skim turns - confirm who is actually living there before you discard anything. Board what is genuinely new to James for first look; fold anything we already have open onto the existing ticket. No duplicate tickets for work that is already live.

When it is locked, short #maintenance wrap covering what moved, what got reversed after QC, what got escalated, what got corrected on the equipment side, and what was new versus already open. I am on calls the rest of the day - do not wait on me.
